skill.summary: Generate images from text prompts using FLUX via Together.ai. Returns image URL. Prompts are auto-enhanced for best results.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release of image-gen-bot.
- Generate images from text prompts using the FLUX model via Together.ai.
- Prompts are automatically enhanced for better visual quality before generation.
- Supports customizable image dimensions and quality settings.
- Returns a URL to the generated image for easy sharing or download.
